changes.title: Cosign signing
changes.summary: SHA256 checksums (Phase 1) prove that a downloaded file matches what was uploaded, but they don't prove who uploaded it. changes.title: Cheatsheets license tiered
changes.summary: The just-archived `cheatsheet-source-layer` mandates verbatim source storage in the repo, which (a) bloats git for material we have no clear redistribution rights to, (b) creates a license-compliance trap for any source NOT explicitly allowlisted, and (c) makes refresh a manual chore that drifts over time. We need a model where license-friendly material is b

changes.title: Forge build observability and diagnostics
changes.summary: Forge image builds take 2+ hours due to re-downloading ~6.5GB of packages on every build, with no visibility into which steps are slowest or largest. Developers can't identify optimization opportunities or diagnose failures in the build or runtime. Container health issues surface only after minutes of silent operation, requiring manual inspection.
